title: Cross-Process Interaction Lease & Web-Wrapper Depth Bypass

claims.assertion: Multi-agent GUI automation requires cross-process file/mutex interaction leases with contention counters for mutations while tree observations remain lock-free, paired with Chromium web-wrapper detection to skip empty container depth on Electron/web applications.

distilled_learning: Mutating desktop application state across multiple agent processes can lead to input collisions. agent-desktop resolves this with an inheritable InteractionLease that tracks contention counts and provides atomic ownership during semantic clicks and typing. For observation, it identifies Chromium provenance (Chrome_WidgetWin_1 on Windows) and skips non-semantic anonymous container wrappers during tree walks, preventing deep web applications from exhausting observation budgets by an order of magnitude.
